decisive_spans.text: Child-Pugh grade C (13 points) end-stage liver failure
Massive pleural effusion in the right lower lung lobe

response.rationale: The patient's Child-Pugh grade C end-stage liver failure and massive pleural effusion strongly support Hepatohydraulic Syndrome. While Spontaneous Bacterial Empyema is also supported by the pleural effusion and its chronicity, the direct link between liver failure and pleural effusion is more specific to Hepatohydraulic Syndrome.
